response.sql:
WITH item_counts AS (
  SELECT oi.product_id,
         AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_qty,
         COUNT(*) AS item_count
  FROM Order_Items oi
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
product_stats AS (
  SELECT ic.product_id,
         pc.product_type_description,
         ic.avg_qty,
         ic.item_count,
         CAST(ic.item_count AS REAL) / SUM(ic.item_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM item_counts ic
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ic.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
),
type_stats AS (
  SELECT product_type_description,
         AVG(avg_qty) AS type_avg_qty,
         AVG(item_count) AS type_avg_count,
         AVG(share) AS type_avg_share
  FROM product_stats
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT AVG(type_avg_qty) AS avg_quantity,
       AVG(type_avg_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
       AVG(type_avg_share) AS avg_share
FROM type_stats;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as numeric text; it is cast to REAL, empty or whitespace-only values are treated as missing (NULL) and skipped by AVG, and any non-numeric text is parsed by SQLite's leading-number cast.
The share denominator is the sum of order-item counts over all included products, which equals the total number of Order_Items rows since every order item's product exists in Products.
A product whose order items all have missing quantities contributes NULL to the quantity average and is skipped in its type's average, not counted as zero.
Products with a NULL product_type_description form their own group in the per-type step, since GROUP BY treats NULL as a single group.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat products with no product type description as missing and exclude them from the per-type averages, so only real product type descriptions are averaged in the final result. Shares still use all included products as the denominator.

WITH item_counts AS (
  SELECT oi.product_id,
         AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_qty,
         COUNT(*) AS item_count
  FROM Order_Items oi
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
product_stats AS (
  SELECT ic.product_id,
         pc.product_type_description,
         ic.avg_qty,
         ic.item_count,
         CAST(ic.item_count AS REAL) / SUM(ic.item_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM item_counts ic
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ic.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
),
type_stats AS (
  SELECT product_type_description,
         AVG(avg_qty) AS type_avg_qty,
